Flake root cause: Sync.Agent fired reflog checkpoint via Task.start and returned; checkpoint's load+mutate+create_chained_commit on root_uuid raced with any concurrent writer (test, remote peer, MCP). In the failing scenario, crdt_file.txt got dropped from root schema → Phase 2 export skipped it → File.read! :enoent. Fixed by running checkpoint synchronously within sync_once (commit 3368000). Also corrected test's misuse of CommitStore.create_commit(root, _, nil) → create_chained_commit. Repro before: ~80% local. Repro after: 10/10 pass. Full suite: yelixer 319/0, commonplace 1071/0, cli 55/0, mcp 44/0, web 41/0. Acceptance met: sustained load → only mandatory fires; bursty load with lull → fires during first post-interesting lull; mandatory always wins; soft-only or lull-only → inert (both required together). CX-1t0t superseded by this work.
